verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform overview lists health insurance as an offering, provided through the third-party partner SimplyInsured (gusto-docs-39). Payroll docs show benefits and deductions flow into payroll runs (gusto-docs-4, gusto-docs-47), and community users confirm offering health insurance through Gusto. Users also report limited plan customization across states and a plan-termination mishap, which temper but do not contradict the capability. missing for 10: documented enrollment workflow, explicit sync of health-insurance deductions to payroll, first-party (non-partner) administration, multi-state plan flexibility, independent corroboration of reliable administration.
